Event Dates: From Feb 13, 2027 to Feb 15, 2027
Entry Deadline: Jan 11, 2027
Details:

The Surf Nation Champions League brings together all U14 teams across the entirety of Surf Nation to showcase their talent at Surf Sports Park in San Diego, CA

 

The 2027 Surf Nation Champions League will feature teams from the u14 age group.

Over four guaranteed matches, players will compete in front of Surf Select scouts and coaches, with the opportunity to be identified for a coveted spot on the Surf Select National Team. Additionally, every game will be filmed and broken down utilizing Taka’s industry-leading match and player analysis tools.

Surf Nation is proud to continue the Surf Select Platinum Program during the 2027 Surf Nation Champions League. Top players in the u14 age group will be scouted and identified during the event for a spot on the Surf Select National team and a fully-funded trip to Surf Cup International Salou, one of Europe’s most prestigious youth football tournaments. Learn more about the Surf Select Platinum Program here.

Tournament Details:

Dates: February 13-15th, 2027

Location: Surf Sports Park, Del Mar CA

Tournament Fee: $1095.00

Please Note – each team will play 4 games including a Monday game. If traveling out of state please do not book a flight prior to 6:00pm Monday February 15th. 

This IS a stay and play event. Teams cannot book hotel rooms until they receive notification of acceptance from the event and any teams based over 100 miles from Surf Sports Park in Del Mar, CA are required to book all reservations through Athlete Travel’s booking system. Booking with Airbnb or any independent booking service or other hotel booking company is not permitted. Teams will be disqualified for not following this policy. There is no opt out option for this policy so please understand that before submitting your application.
